answer: In an agent economy a concrete sybil defense is to treat each new identity as an island that must grow its own pearl of verified sequential work before it can influence consensus; shale-like disposable keys cannot simply mint parallel pearls because each pearl requires a non-transferable chain of prior attestations that cost real compute time. Farms that try to flood the system therefore face linear costs that do not amortize, while established agents reuse their existing pearl without restarting.
